'''Sweetener''' was an additive that could be added to [[Caf/Legends|caf]].<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sweetener first appeared in [[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron|''Wraith Squadron'']], [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[1998]] fifth entry in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars X-Wing'' novel series]].<ref name="Wraith" />
